name: oi_failed_breakdown_recoil
objective: Add a causal long sleeve that improves the frozen Gross9 portfolio by monetizing failed downside continuation after leveraged short inventory builds.

anchor: completed 4h BTC log return is in the calibration q20 lower tail
one-bar-delayed 4h OI-minus-price divergence is in the calibration upper tail
completed 1h taker imbalance is in the calibration lower tail
completed close is in the calibration q25 lower tail of its trailing 4h high-low range
confirmation: wait a fixed 30m or 60m after the anchor
completed close reclaims the anchor close
completed fast taker flow is greater than anchor 1h taker flow
one-bar-delayed OI has not fallen more than the frozen retention allowance
post-anchor downside excursion is no larger than 1.5 times the pre-anchor 1h ATR
completed close finishes in the frozen upper fraction of the post-anchor range
mechanism.trade: enter LONG at the next 5m open after confirmation; fixed hold; no take-profit or stop

causality_contract.rolling_features: trailing-only and inclusive of the completed decision bar

execution_contract.annualization: declared full calendar window including all idle cash time
execution_contract.strict_mdd: global high-water mark with same-BTC completed-bar upper-before-lower OHLC path

pre2024_shortlist.rank: maximize minimum(calibration ratio, 2023 ratio), then 2023 ratio, then lower MDD, then lexicographic parameter order

requirements: Gross9 plus weight 0.25 must improve 2024 CAGR/strict-MDD without lowering absolute return
test2024_top1.rank: maximize the minimum Gross9 portfolio ratio across 2023 and 2024, then 2024 marginal ratio improvement, then standalone 2024 ratio, then lower weight/gross

requirements: 10bp/side stress remains positive in both future windows
adding the frozen sleeve does not reduce Gross9 absolute return or CAGR/strict-MDD in either future window

required_diagnostics: exact entry Jaccard versus every Gross9 sleeve
zero-filled daily MTM Pearson and Spearman correlation
candidate contribution on the worst 20 Gross9 drawdown bars
overlap with REX short positions and Rank7/Markov long positions
orthogonality_contract.exception: A higher REX-short overlap is allowed only when the candidate is opposite-side, the frozen portfolio marginal test improves strict MDD, and overlap is reported rather than hidden.

research_caveat: The wider programme has previously inspected 2025 and 2026. This freeze prevents new future reranking but cannot make those calendars globally pristine. Any passing result remains forward-shadow only.
